York_direction.inputs: rho/rho_R/rho_Z from original normal chi lift; W value/R/Z uses original four-row normal registration; t uses original scalar value lift.
York_direction.complete_formula: dh=4rho*h; dI=-4rho*I; dT=(-4rho)*T+inverse_lam*dBW; dtau=mu_owned*t; dc=dh:T+h:dT; dk=dh:I+h:dI; dpart=(dtau-dc-cached_trace_part*dk)/cached_kappa; dPi=dT+cached_trace_part*dI+dpart*I.
York_direction.dBW: Source FY128 fixed L_maps times W_jet, ordered sum(axis2) then sum(axis1), raised by fixed target_raising_inverse on both sides and multiplied by fixed mu_owned.
York_direction.retained_defects: Keep actual h:I=kappa, cached quotient, nonsymmetric raw tensor, exact fy_div association and analytic/formal inverse/measure plus owned-target-anchor bridges. No ideal kappa=3 or dk=0 substitution.
York_direction.packing: Physical target covectors RR,ZZ,phiphi,RZ,Rphi,Zphi use diagonal entry and ij+ji once for offdiagonal slots; no extra factor2.

signs.canonical: Dcurrent-DYtarget; subtraction is metric only, fixed native and phase priors do not vary. DY includes chi as well as W and t.
signs.normal: normal point coefficients are total Hamiltonian derivatives: ordinary mean minus native/EH/phase action; sheet contributes plus its ordinary normal-density derivative once.
signs.time_primary: negative normal_coefficients[:,:,3], unweighted point field, separate from spatial normal scatter.
signs.W_t_direct: Mechanical/phase current, all16 normal coefficients, CMC, sheet and time-primary direct W/t entries are exactly zero in this fixed-rate source scope. DY_W and DY_t generally nonzero; induced temporal feedback is therefore not zero.

original_maps.normal_mask: chi/W: row0 axis excluded; outer/top test values zero; W_Z sheet j0 excluded. Extend even axis row0=row1 except the odd component; restrict combines axis before original masks.
original_maps.W_R_and_normal_radial_shift: normal row1 hats=(R*hat, R*hat_R+hat, R*hat_Z); retain rounded operands and original corner order.
original_maps.native_left: point native99 reshaped33x15136x3; multiply dv/R then valuehat with component2 R^2; fold axis components1,2 into row1, then original native mask.
original_maps.metric_left: Physical6 to coefficient6 by original F^T contraction first, then dv/R, then valuehat separately. Physical E mapping=(a+R^2 b,f,R^2 a,R d,R^3 c,R^2 e); fold all axis coefficients; original sheet slots3:5 zero.
original_maps.scalar_left: Phase and CMC each use dv/R once then valuehat; row0 folds into row1. Scalar3870 outer/top coordinates remain free.
original_maps.normal_left: Use only normal_coefficients[:,:,:3] with original paired_scatter_normal, dv/R once, normal_hat_jet registration, original normal mask. No time jet in spatial scatter.
original_maps.sheet: chi only, original fixed radial indices/right weights and fixed same-position labels at Z=0. Interpolate chi with scalar axis lift; ordinary delta force uses radial factorR in row1, no volume dv/R weight; original normal axis restriction/masks once. No sheet CMC or time-primary term.

Freezing W/t target or assuming t is K_Gamma.
Using generic scalar hats for W_R or generic masks for chi/W.
Dropping jet3 time-primary or weighting/scattering it as a spatial normal row.
Applying dv/R twice, folding aliases after products, or doubling physical offdiagonals twice.
Adding phase or ordinary mean twice, omitting sheet, or adding sheet volume weight.
Using absolute signed target/sheet outputs or FY trace-only envelopes as a complete unsigned source bound.
